messages:
maria: Quick callout — product wants to deprecate the legacy `X-Route-Preference` header in 6 weeks. Planning to show a console deprecation banner and surface affected SDKs. Thoughts on a safe graceback approach?
ben: +1 need a graceful SDK story. can't break customer infra mid-Q.
sam: what does "graceback" mean here? fallback to old header if new one missing?
maria: yep, two-part plan: 1) Console shows affected tenants and samples of calls that rely on the header. 2) SDKs get a 3-release graceful adapter that warns but still sends the legacy header unless explicitly opted out.
jess: console side: we can surface a toggle per-tenant for "legacy routing compatibility" and an exportable CSV of affected API keys. low lift?
ben: console export would help support outreach. also need telemetry hooks so we can count % of requests using legacy header over time.
console-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/console-routing-deprecations -> canary at 2024-05-12 03:00 UTC :calendar:
maria: telemetry: add a `routing.header.variant` dimension (values: "legacy","new","none"). SDKs should set it when they send requests. that'll let us map adoption by client language.
sam: SDK ergonomics: default adapter should be behind a feature flag in each SDK repo. default = enabled for 2 months, then changed to disabled in release that coincides with console banner end-date. release notes will call it out.
jess: UX question: do we add a warning toast during rollout or only show in tenant overview? that toast could be noisy for big orgs.
maria: prefer tenant overview + admin banner, not per-user toasts. keep it admin-facing.
ben: breaking change plan: we must publish a compatibility matrix in docs and include snippet for patching server proxies (Envoy filter) in the migration guide.
sam: for python client: implement adapter in a minor release 1.4.x, emit DeprecationWarning and logger.warn. then next minor 1.5.x will flip default off. docs include `ENV_VAR=REDWOOD_LEGACY_ROUTING=1` opt-back-in.
jess: console telemetry pipeline: we need to add a late-binding transform to backfill older events where header present but not explicitly flagged. storage cost OK?
ben: storage cheap for short window, but backfill should be limited to 30 days. we only need trend signals for the migration window.
maria: coordination checklist: - console banner deploy date - SDK adapter release schedule (py/ts/go) - telemetry dimension + backfill window - support CSV export - doc + migration snippets - customer comms draft
console-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.internal/checklists/routing-deprecation-1717512345 :white_check_mark:
sam: TS SDK note: TS implementation should avoid breaking types. expose `RoutingCompat` config with default true; deprecation warning via `console.warn` in browsers and `process.emitWarning` in node.
ben: Go SDK: can't use runtime warnings; add `log.Warnf` and a debug endpoint `/internal/version` that shows current compatibility flag. ops can scrape it.
jess: telemetry schema PR ready, need review: https://git.internal/redwood/obs/pull/782 — has dimension, enum docs, and backfill job definition.
maria: can we add a console dashboard tile that shows top 10 tenants still using legacy header and % change week-over-week? ops wants that for comms.
ben: yes, that's doable once telemetry dimension is live. tile will query sampled logs + metrics.
sam: risk: some early clients use custom proxies that re-write headers. we should detect by mismatch between SDK version and header presence. flag those tenants for manual outreach.
maria: good call. add heuristic: if SDK version < adapter-release and `routing.header.variant == "new"`, mark as "proxy rewrite".
enjess: will add to support CSV as extra column. (typo: meant jess)
ben: timeline proposal: Week 0: announce deprecation. Week 1-2: console banner + telemetry live. Week 3-6: SDK adapter releases (py/ts/go). Week 7: flip TS/Go defaults off. Week 9: remove legacy header acceptance server-side with 2-week grace for immediate rollbacks.
maria: legal/security ok with timeline. product will approve customer comms next week.
sam: small ask: add a `--force-legacy` CLI arg in SDKs for quick testing by SEs.
jess: support CSV should include `suspected_proxy_rewrite` boolean + contact owner column.
console-bot: Note: please add migration guide docs to docs/site before SDKs ship.
maria: I'll own the docs draft. assigning follow-ups in the checklist. thanks all. :thumbsup:
